evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/rentals.rs:166-177 — report_err() maps the non-RowNotFound branch to (INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("{ctx}: {e}")), interpolating the raw sqlx::Error straight into the client-facing response body. Used by generate_report_preview (L1742) and create_report (L1768), both manager-facing POST endpoints under /api/v1/rentals/reports*.
backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/rentals.rs:1700-1702 — list reports handler returns (INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Failed to list reports: {}", e)) with the raw sqlx error in the body.

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/rentals.rs:1278 — upload_guest_id_document returns ErrorResponse::new("DATABASE_ERROR", format!("Failed to look up guest: {e}")); further raw-{e} leaks in the same multipart flow at L1404 (record ID document), L1445 (link document to guest), L1491 (look up ID document), and L1232 (map_multipart_err BAD_REQUEST body).

Impact: raw sqlx::Error Display exposes DB internals (SQLSTATE codes, table/column names, constraint names, and in some variants connection/pool detail) to any authenticated manager caller. Same leak class the dispatcher already shipped a fix for in listings.rs (signals/2026-11-06-api-handlers-tier1d.json code-review-listings-rs-raw-db-error-leak) but this is a distinct file (rentals.rs) requiring its own fix. Landable backend-only change: log e via tracing::error! and return a generic stable message/code, matching the safe pattern already used in registry.rs:139-145 (registry_db_error).

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/admin_tenant_lifecycle.rs:189-194,206,237,244 — the tenant restore/export endpoints return raw internal error strings in the client body: multipart errors format!("multipart: {e}")/"read field: {e}", filesystem errors format!("write tmp: {e}"), and crucially L237 format!("manifest load failed at {path:?}: {e}") leaks the server-side manifest filesystem path, and internal() (L244) returns tenant_ops::TenantOpsError::to_string() to the caller.

Impact: information disclosure of server filesystem layout (temp dir, manifest path) and internal error detail. Lower severity than rentals.rs because these are platform-admin-gated (RequestPrincipal) endpoints, so exposure is narrow — scored low (+1). Fix: log the detail and return a generic (StatusCode, "restore failed"/"export failed") message, consistent with the generic-error pattern used elsewhere in the segment.
